changelog:
ClawFlare 0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Publish web content (HTML or static directories) to Cloudflare Pages with robust agent workflows.
- Supports account and project selection, new project creation, and deployment via API token authentication.
- Provides clear, structured deployment results including live URLs and statuses.
- Includes safety/confirmation for production publishes and helpful error handling.
- Focuses on static content only; no server functions or complex build pipelines in MVP.
